figures.Fig18.10: Gene linkage in Drosophila (PDF page 102). Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch18-fig-18-10-gene-linkage (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book's linkage example (wing length and abdomen width, F1 x F1, only parental types in 3:1) differs from Morgan's commonly cited linkage experiments (body colour and wing length, analysed by testcrosses, with some recombinants). A pure 3:1 from F1 x F1 requires complete linkage. The lesson keeps the book's example, flagged.
'13,000 genes on 4 chromosome' and 'they did no assort' are read as chromosomes and did not. The For Information box is carried.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
